$Comment: A Grit Oiler's gritty oil hurts the Heartwinder (DESIGN.md 6.2, 7.6; raised from -100 for Gibson's round 2 note 27). Real damage now, a DamageCalculator fired once (vanilla Tests/Damage.json: no cooldown, one cycle), so the boss flinches and its bar drops; the old StatModifiers -100 was a silent stat change (ActiveEntityEffect.tickStatChanges) with no hurt and 2% of its health. The applier is not recorded (ActionApplyEntityEffect passes no owner), so the source is the effect itself: the boss's DisableDamageGroups (which name the robots) do not cancel it (NPCDamageSystems only filters EntitySource), and invulnerability still does. No combat numbers: the server only sends those to a player who dealt the hit (DamageSystems.EntityUIEvents), so the title says the number instead.
